guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 将你的钱包连接到 PERPTools
guide.description: 打开 PERPTools 应用并点击“连接钱包”。第一次连接时，你签署一次性链上注册以创建你的交易账户。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the PERPTools app and click “Connect Wallet”. On first connection you sign a one-time on-chain registration that creates your trading account.

guide.title: 存款 USDC 抵押资产
guide.description: 点击“存款”，然后将 USDC、USDT 或 Solana 发送到你的交易账户。没有存款费用，也没有最低交易额。如果你需要 USDC，你可以在 Bybit 上购买它，并使用下面的组件提取或转移你已经在另一条链上持有的资金。跨链资金无需离开此页面即可在 30+ 链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。立即跨链打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开跨链页面
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click “Deposit,” and send USDC, USDT or Solana to your trading account. There is no deposit fee and no minimum for trading. If you need USDC, you can buy it on Bybit and withdraw or move funds you already hold on another chain with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 贸易永续合约
guide.description: 打开交易终端，选择市场，然后下达市价单或限价单。交易量和持仓量都会影响你的每周得分。标准市场对挂单订单收取 0.01% 费用，对吃单订单收取 0.046% 费用。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the trading terminal, pick a market, and place a market or limit order. Volume and open interest both feed your weekly score. Standard markets charge 0.01% for maker orders and 0.046% for taker orders.

guide.title: 贸易现货市场
guide.description: 切换到现货并在列出的货币对之间进行交换。现货交易量可赚取季节 2 积分，而 PERPTools 目前对现货交易收取 0% 费用。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Switch to spot and swap between listed pairs. Spot volume earns Season 2 points, and PERPTools currently charges 0% fees on spot trades.

guide.title: 在 AI Arena 中资助人工智能代理
guide.description: 使用 Solana 钱包打开 AI Arena。代理仅接受 USDC，你有两种方式： 创建自己的代理：设置其风险和杠杆限制，描述策略，然后在检查其盈亏和交易历史后将存款存入现有代理代理交易和代理存款均可赚取积分。创建一个没有资金的代理是不会赚到任何钱的。每次从代理提款的费用为 1 USDC，最多可能需要 24 小时。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund an AI Agent in AI Arena
guide.original_description: Open AI Arena with a Solana wallet. Agents accept USDC only, and you have two ways in: Create your own agent: set its risk and leverage limits, describe the strategy, then deposit Deposit into an existing agent after checking its PnL and trade history Agent trading and agent deposits both earn points. Creating an agent without funding it earns nothing. Each withdrawal from an agent costs 1 USDC and can take up to 24 hours.

guide.title: 分享你的邀请链接
guide.description: 从推荐页面复制你的个人链接。你将获得相当于你推荐用户赚取的 10% 积分，加上他们在 USDC 中支付的交易费用的基础 10% 份额。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Copy your personal link from the Referral page. You receive points equal to 10% of what your referred users earn, plus a base 10% share of their trading fees paid in USDC.

guide.title: 检查你的每周积分
guide.description: 每周五分配后访问积分页面，查看你的分配和排名。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the Points page after each Friday distribution to see your allocation and rank.
